description: Read a presenter drawing by the id describe_presenter answered: status checking, then drawing, then ready, or refused from checking or from drawing. While it is checking or drawing, call it again every few seconds; ready and refused are final, and a drawing not finished within 5 minutes reads as refused. Ready answers pictures, up to 3, each with its number and a url that opens it for the next hour, made new in every answer, and voice, the voice the description said: woman, man or empty. Refused answers error.message, why it could not be drawn, a drawing that failed among them. keep_presenter keeps one picture by its number, and the id then answers not_found. Free.
name: get_described
title: A presenter drawn
